text:
Nia: hi all, first week here — opened my first PR and getting lint + CI failures. can someone point me to the minimal PR checklist?

Chris: welcome! short checklist: 1) branch name: feat/ENG-<num>-short-desc; 2) title: [ENG-123] One-line summary; 3) run formatter & linter locally; 4) include testing steps in body.

Nia: thanks. where is CONTRIBUTING.md?

Chris: top-level CONTRIBUTING.md in repo root. also see docs/dev/process/pr-review.md for reviewer expectations.

merge-bot: CI #4701 failed  eslint error in packages/core/src/utils.ts:23  https://ci.redwood/build/4701

Alex: run `pnpm -w run lint -- --fix` then stage fixes. if CI still fails, run `scripts/check-pr.sh` to emulate CI.

Nia: done, linter fixed. quick question: how many reviewers do I need?

Chris: default 1 for frontend, 2 for backend/core. ensure CODEOWNERS approves if you touch owned files. also prefer small focused PRs.

Nia: perfect, will tidy history and request reviews. thanks!
